title: nanoKONTROL 2 control map
description: Binds physical nanoKONTROL 2 controls (defined in nk2-layout.json) to application targets, and records application targets whose MIDI CC has no control on the surface. The device layout describes the hardware; this map describes what the running app does with it.

device.description: Path (relative to this file) to the device layout this map refers to.

identifier.description: Device control id as used in the layout file (e.g. ch1.fader, transport.play).

cc.description: MIDI Control Change number the app listens on.

control.description: Device control id from the layout. Omit when the CC has no control on this surface (e.g. an external controller).

target.description: Application-side binding name (e.g. slider0, prevPreset, hueLfoDepth).

kind.description: continuous = analog value; trigger = edge/fired event.

scope.description: global = fixed target; preset = target depends on the active preset.

range.description: Optional input/output mapping applied to the incoming value.

condition.description: Runtime condition under which this binding is active.
